title: Developing LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems in Software Engineering: A Mixed-Method Experience Report
abstract: arXiv:2608.11965v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The proliferation of Generative Artificial Intelligence (Gen AI) powered by large language models (LLMs) has transformed the software development process, introducing new paradigms for code generation, debugging, testing, and maintenance. While early applications focused on leveraging single, independent LLMs to assist developers with isolated tasks, recent advances have shifted toward multi-agent systems (MAS) that orchestrate multiple LLM-based agents working collaboratively toward common objectives. Despite their promising potential, using MAS encompasses a set of challenges for developers who have to carefully select the right technology, devise proper coordination rules, and design specific roles for the involved agents. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive overview of the existing tools and frameworks for implementing MAS in software engineering. First, we conducted a quantitative analysis of the most relevant open source MAS

translated_title: 基于LLM的软件工程多智能体系统开发：一项混合方法经验报告
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11965v1 公告类型：新 摘要：由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的生成式人工智能（Gen AI）的普及已彻底改变了软件开发过程，引入了代码生成、调试、测试和维护的新范式。早期应用侧重于利用单个独立的LLM协助开发者完成孤立任务，而最近的进展已转向多智能体系统（MAS），该系统协调多个基于LLM的智能体协同工作以实现共同目标。尽管MAS具有巨大潜力，但使用MAS给开发者带来了一系列挑战，他们必须仔细选择合适的技术、制定适当的协调规则，并为涉及的智能体设计特定角色。在本文中，我们全面概述了在软件工程中实施MAS的现有工具和框架。首先，我们对最相关的开源MAS进行了定量分析。
tldr: 本文通过混合方法对软件工程中基于LLM的多智能体系统进行了全面概述，分析了现有工具和框架，并总结了开发者在实施MAS时面临的关键挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a comprehensive mixed-method overview of LLM-based multi-agent systems in software engineering, analyzing existing tools and frameworks while summarizing key challenges developers face in implementation.
